The '''Echani Firedancers''' were [[Martial artist/Legends|martial artists]] who combined fighting techniques with exotic weapons; the usage of the two together almost seemed like a mesmerizing dance. [[Echani/Legends|Echani]] Firedancers made use of [[Echani Ritual Brand|ritual brands]] that were heated on both ends, which caused burn wounds to enemies struck by the weapon.
